name: Paragraph-count tally
instruction: Count how many paragraphs the story has. Score 1.0 when there are many (roughly fifteen or more), 0.5 for a moderate number, 0.0 when there are only one or two. Count the paragraph breaks only; pay no attention to whether anything develops across them.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow structural counterpart of R5A01 'Elaboration beyond the inciting gimmick': paragraph count is the typographic residue of elaboration while measuring nothing about whether the premise is actually developed.

name: Sentence-final ellipsis count
instruction: Count how many sentences end in an ellipsis ('...' or '…'). Score 1.0 when several do, 0.5 for one or two, 0.0 for none. Count the punctuation only; pay no attention to what is being left unsaid.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow typographic counterpart of R5A06 'Recontextualizing ending': trailing ellipses are the surface mark of an open or suspended close while measuring nothing about whether the ending reframes what preceded it.
